|strategy=By [mailto:GrdAdmSpam@aol.com Marc Longenecker]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/dagobah/dark/small/closecall.html</ref>

A good way to get rid of pesky rebel mains is to use a combination of [[Scanning Crew]] and [[Close Call]]. Play [[Scanning Crew]] and move a low-destiny rebel to your opponents used pile. Then play [[Close Call]], causing them to reveal the top cards of their force, reserve, and used piles, and then to lose those cards of the lowest destiny greater than 0. If you are lucky, you might even knock off another card in addition to the one you removed

lose [[Close Call]].
